children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on GMR Airports

GMRAIRPO reported EBITDA of Rs14.8bn (2% yoy), 6%/2% above Emkay/consensus estimates. Passenger growth remained subdued at 1% yoy (-3% on LFL basis) during the quarter. Revenue grew 12% yoy, aided by growth in non-aero revenue and commissioning of Nagpur and Vizag airports. Aero YPP stood at Rs497 (6%/12% yoy/qoq), while non-aero IPP saw healthy sequential growth of 12% to Rs772. Passenger traffic outlook remains positive in 2HFY27, supported by seasonality factors and slot requirement from airlines, while nonaero income is expected to remain resilient.

We have reduced our FY27-29E EBITDA by 1-3% on revising passenger traffic assumptions in GHIAL and MOPA. We reiterate BUY on GMRAIRPO, with an unchanged SOTP-based TP of Rs120, based on 23x implied FY29E EV/EBITDA.
